owner_accepted_business_rules: Roles: PICKER, REPORTER, ADMIN, ROOT.
Picker reports out-of-stock SKU; unresolved dedupe is Picker + SKU.
Multiple Pickers reporting the same SKU share one processing batch while retaining separate report tickets.
Reporter priority remains higher affected Picker count first; tie-breaker earlier first_report_at.
Picker may withdraw unresolved mistaken report within 60 seconds server time.
Resolution values are HAS_STOCK and SKIP_ALLOWED; SKIP_ALLOWED may be corrected to HAS_STOCK within 5 minutes server time.
Report ticket, processing batch and lifecycle/audit event remain separate semantics.
Operational authority is Worker + InventoryCore SQLite; Google Sheets/Drive are source/archive/support systems only.
There is no offline business mode or offline transaction fallback.
D057 direct legacy presentation transplant is the active visual/layout authority; old running Web/APK presentation plus read-only UI source are source-of-truth.
Picker PDA uses vertical SKU input, selected SKU/product, full-width BÁO HẾT HÀNG and today history.
Reporter PDA keeps four business-state filters with large CÓ HÀNG / CHO SKIP HÀNG actions and explicit Skip impact confirmation.
Admin/Root PDA must have a concise operational launcher and must not render as only Reporter.
Foreground realtime upgrades to monotonic sequence plus bounded delta recovery and context-preserving patching.
Critical HAS_STOCK/SKIP_ALLOWED results require explicit Picker acknowledgement tied to target user + result event + batch/version; ACK does not redefine business resolution.
SLA is explicit configurable warning/escalation only; it never auto-Skips/resolves and does not silently replace canonical queue ordering.
Resolved shortage episodes are immutable; later same-SKU shortage creates a new batch linked to the previous resolved episode.
Diagnostics are bounded/redacted and never expose credentials/session/signing material.
HR source is Admin/Root configurable with Google Sheet URL, exact tab and configurable employee/name columns; Picker lifecycle remains explicit Admin/Root authority.
SKU Excel imports support 10,000-50,000 rows using bounded idempotent chunks and explicit conflict handling.
Android Beta must verify latest valid signed Beta version before login.
